  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds, establishing Card as the sole adverse family. No other rule holds, no household exception changes the family count, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row (b) applies, but the failed required id_check now decides the disposition under §5.3(b): recommend decline. Escalation is prohibited because Linkage is absent. A legitimate foreign-card customer with an AVS mismatch is plausible, but cannot override failed verification. The order has shipped, so the loss stands; decline blocks the account rather than preventing shipment. No further check would change the policy decision."
